svg.title: WORM progression and enemy balance graphs
svg.desc: Worm level point requirements and bite strength from level zero through one hundred, plus enemy health and point values with bite-match worm levels.
svg.text: Next-level cost = ceil(5 × 1.3^level) · Bite = 2 × 1.25^level · logarithmic value axis
The game has no enemy-level stat. “Bite-match L#” is the first worm level whose bite strength is at least that enemy’s HP.
Generated from game.js · 101 worm levels · 6 enemy types · values current at generation time
